Introduction

Tools and Equipment
Cleaning materials (cloth - kerosene)
Tool set
Work to be Carried Out
Drain the oil
Unscrew the exhaust, wash it out with oil and blow it out with 
 compressed air.
Remove contact s and chamber element s, check them for are 
 erosion and replace as necessary
Clean the head, the oil level gauge, the protective tube, the 
 float of the oil level
Retighten the bolts securing the connections
Grease all bearing, joints and sliding surfaces
Carry out test operation manually
Measure the resistance between terminals
